summary: Your seventh teach-back. You list everything that goes into one model call, explain context engineering about your own assistant in 5 sentences or a voice note, check six key points, and count the tokens of each part of one call, then see the history take over at 51 turns.
goal: Explain in 5 sentences what goes into the context of a call, and show where the tokens go.

items.text: List everything that goes into one model call and which part you almost forgot
Explain context engineering with your assistant as the example in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Run context_parts.py and see the system prompt as the biggest part, then 51 turns of history
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap using the two tables
Play the Context Counter game to the end and see your score
